title: GDScript: a script whose base class failed to compile stays valid and is instantiated with uninitialized members, crashing typed code (SIGSEGV)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935], v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4], v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf], v4.8.dev7.official [c971f93e7].
- On 4.8-dev7 the `.new()` variant below raises a script error instead (a side effect of GH-119932); the resource-load and `set_script` variants still crash.

### System information

Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS on WSL2 (kernel 6.18.33.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2) - official Linux x86_64 editor binaries - reproduced with `--headless` - 11th Gen Intel Core i7-11370H (6 threads available)

### Issue description

If a script's base class fails to compile, Godot still lets me create an instance of a script that extends it. The variables that it then inherits are never initialized and are null. 

Then, at runtime in typed code, I get a SIGSEGV engine crash when attempting to use the inherited values.

I found this when running a script with `-s`. My base class references an autoload. Under `-s` the base class fails to compile with `Identifier not found`. Some quick research with an agent found GH-80319 as a related issue. 

In the MRP, `Base` has `var list: Array[int]`, and `for x in t.list` on a `Derived` instance crashes. 

Expected: Creating the instance fails, or accessing the bad value is a normal script error.

Actual: The engine crashes.

Output on 4.7.2:

```
SCRIPT ERROR: Compile Error: Identifier not found: Auto
          at: GDScript::reload (res://base.gd:8)
SCRIPT ERROR: Compile Error: Failed to compile depended scripts.
          at: GDScript::reload (res://derived.gd:0)
SCRIPT ERROR: Compile Error: Failed to compile depended scripts.
          at: GDScript::reload (res://main.gd:0)
ERROR: Failed to load script "res://main.gd" with error "Compilation failed".
   at: load (modules/gdscript/gdscript_resource_format.cpp:46)
(res://derived.gd):<GDScript#-9223372010531322433>
ERROR: Parameter "p_script->implicit_initializer" is null.
   at: _super_implicit_constructor (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:146)
   GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] _ready (res://auto.gd:7)
t.get(list) = <null>

================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.official (ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079)
...
GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
    [0] _ready (res://auto.gd:10)
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create the six files below in an empty folder.
2. `godot --headless --path . --import` (builds the global class cache).
3. `godot --headless --path . -s main.gd`


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

`project.godot`
```
config_version=5

[application]

config/name="implicit-initializer-mrp"

[autoload]

Auto="*res://auto.gd"
```

`base.gd`
```gdscript
class_name Base
extends Resource

@export var list: Array[int] = [1, 2, 3]


func touch() -> void:
	print(Auto.name)
```

`derived.gd`
```gdscript
class_name Derived
extends Base
```

`thing.tres`
```
[gd_resource type="Resource" script_class="Derived" format=3]

[ext_resource type="Script" path="res://derived.gd" id="1"]

[resource]
script = ExtResource("1")
```

`auto.gd`
```gdscript
extends Node

var things: Array[Derived] = []


func _ready() -> void:
	things.append(load("res://thing.tres"))
	for t in things:
		print("t.get(list) = ", t.get("list"))
		for x in t.list:
			print(x)
	print("autoload survived")
```

`main.gd`
```gdscript
extends SceneTree


func _initialize() -> void:
	print(Derived)
	quit()
```

A shorter variant needs no autoload code and no resource: make `base.gd` extend `RefCounted`, and in `main.gd` write `var d := Derived.new()` followed by `for x in d.list: print(x)`. It crashes on 4.6.2, 4.6.3 and 4.7.2. Replacing `Derived.new()` with `var r := RefCounted.new()`, `r.set_script(Derived)`, `var d: Derived = r` crashes on 4.8-dev7 as well.

---

[implicit-initializer-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33037186/implicit-initializer-mrp.zip)
